title: Control plane: budget-check endpoint + initial policy hook (warn-only)
author: Benji Okafor
release_notes: Internal-only: adds a control-plane endpoint for querying error budget status and wires a minimal policy-evaluation hook (warn-only). No customer-facing behavior changes.
description: Context: As part of the tiered SLO + error budget enforcement work, we need a single, stable API in the control plane that CI/CD and rollout tooling can call to determine whether a deploy should proceed (initially warn-only; later PRs will add block modes and overrides). This PR adds (1) an internal budget-check endpoint in the control plane that returns current budget state for a given scope (tier/service/region), and (2) an initial hook in the policy engine that allows callers to request a policy decision including budget context. Motivation: unblock ENG-2422 (CI gate wiring) without forcing CI to speak directly to the SLO toolkit storage or observability stack, and standardize the contract early so we can evolve enforcement in one place. API: POST /internal/reliability/budgets/check (auth: service-to-service only) Request fields: tier (hosted|dedicated), service (string), region (optional), window (default 30d), mode (default warn_only). Response fields: status (ok|at_risk|exhausted|unknown), remaining_fraction (0..1), burn_rate_1h (optional), burn_rate_6h (optional), as_of (RFC3339), reasons (list), recommended_action (string). Note: this endpoint is intentionally conservative and returns status=unknown when budget data is missing; callers should treat unknown as warn-only until we have full coverage. Implementation notes: - Adds BudgetStatusClient interface in control plane that calls the existing slo-toolkit budget store (via internal gRPC) with a small caching layer (60s TTL) to reduce load during CI fanout. - Adds request validation and canonicalization: tier/service required, region optional, window constrained to {7d,30d}. - Adds initial policy engine integration: PolicyDecision now optionally includes budget_status and a budget_signal enum, but the decision path does not block any action yet (the budget signal is returned for logging/CI display only). - Emits structured audit log event reliability.budget_check with scope + caller identity (service principal) + returned status for later debugging of false positives/negatives. Security: endpoint is behind internal auth (mTLS + service principal allowlist). No user tokens accepted. Rate limit: basic per-caller limit (defaults 20 RPS) to protect control plane. Testing: unit tests for request validation and mapping from store response -> API response; integration test with a fake budget store; contract tests for JSON schema used by deploy pipeline. Follow-ups (not in this PR): - Add override tokens + TTL and audit trail (tracked in ENG-2422 / later PR). - Add block/soft-block modes and policy gating behavior once we have burn-rate alerting calibrated. - Expose status in Console via a dedicated read path (separate auth and permissions).
commits: cp-api: add BudgetStatusClient + internal handler for /internal/reliability/budgets/check
policy-engine: plumb BudgetSignal into PolicyDecision (warn-only) and add logging
authz: restrict endpoint to service principals and add per-caller rate limiting
tests: add contract tests + fake budget store integration test
docs: internal API docs + example curl requests for CI gate integration
review_conversation: Ethan Park: Can we confirm this is internal-only and cannot be hit with customer API keys? The route name /internal/* is not sufficient by itself. Benji Okafor: Yep. Added explicit auth gate: requires service principal (mTLS) and rejects any user token path. I also added an allowlist config so we can start with CI + perf-canary only. Jordan Lee: The PolicyDecision shape change worries me a bit; will this break any existing callers deserializing responses? Benji Okafor: Good call. I made budget_status optional and gated it behind include_budget=true query param on the internal endpoint (policy eval only adds fields when requested). Existing internal callers don’t set that flag today, so response remains unchanged. Nadia Rahman: For unknown/missing budget data, why not fail closed? I’m worried CI will start ignoring unknowns. Benji Okafor: For the pilot we want warn-only so we don’t block hotfixes due to incomplete backfill. Added explicit status=unknown and recommended_action="warn_only". Follow-up will move select services to soft-block once coverage is complete and backfill is validated. Aisha Bello: Please include burn_rate windows in response to help triage (1h/6h are what we’re standardizing). Also: make sure reasons include which SLI is burning when available. Benji Okafor: Added burn_rate_1h and burn_rate_6h plus a reasons[] list. SLI attribution depends on store output; I added placeholders and pass through when present. Ethan Park: Caching: 60s TTL seems fine, but ensure cache key includes tier/service/region/window. Benji Okafor: Confirmed; cache key is full scope. Added test to prevent collisions. Jordan Lee: Approving after the optional-field gating change. Aisha Bello: Approving; thanks for adding the explicit unknown semantics and structured audit logs.
post_merge_notes: Deployed to staging control plane. CI gate will start consuming this endpoint in warn-only mode once ENG-2422 lands. Monitor audit log volume for budget_check and ensure rate limits are not tripping during CI fanout.
